podcast.body: In the spring of 1970, The Beatles' penultimate single, "Let It Be," debuted on the Hot 100 at number six, resetting the benchmark for the highest debut ever on the chart. This record held for a quarter century, from 1970 until 1995, when it was finally surpassed by Michael Jackson's "Scream." "the Beatles reset the benchmark again when their penultimate single let it be debuted on the Hot 100 at a lofty number six."
